en.name: Naoki Kitajima
en.bio: I'm a Bboy! A full-stack engineer covering everything from frontend (React/Next.js/TypeScript) to cloud infrastructure and SRE for payment platforms at a major tech company. I graduated from Tokyo University of Science with a degree in Physics, then built experience across multiple startups before joining my current role on a payment infrastructure team. Outside of code, coffee and street dance fuel my creativity.
